command_line:
set -eu
echo "Python version:" > env_report.txt
python --version >> env_report.txt 2>&1 || echo "no python" >> env_report.txt
echo "Pip version:" >> env_report.txt
pip --version >> env_report.txt 2>&1 || echo "no pip" >> env_report.txt
echo "Conda version:" >> env_report.txt
conda --version >> env_report.txt 2>&1 || echo "no conda" >> env_report.txt
echo "Checking statsmodels:" >> env_report.txt
python -c 'import statsmodels; print(statsmodels.__version__)' >> env_report.txt 2>&1 || echo "statsmodels not installed" >> env_report.txt
echo "Checking pandas:" >> env_report.txt
python -c 'import pandas; print(pandas.__version__)' >> env_report.txt 2>&1 || echo "pandas not installed" >> env_report.txt
echo "Checking scipy:" >> env_report.txt
python -c 'import scipy; print(scipy.__version__)' >> env_report.txt 2>&1 || echo "scipy not installed" >> env_report.txt
echo "Checking numpy:" >> env_report.txt
python -c 'import numpy; print(numpy.__version__)' >> env_report.txt 2>&1 || echo "numpy not installed" >> env_report.txt
echo "done" >> env_report.txt
